description: The minimum negative-vector set v1/spec.md §8 requires an implementation to reject, plus VEC-A2A-GATE-1 and VEC-A2A-RESP-1. Each id is implemented by exactly one test in every language runner for this suite - see run-a2a-gate-vectors.mjs for the Node/TypeScript runner.

vectors.description: A proof whose audience names a DID other than this server MUST be rejected.
A proof whose expires has already passed (beyond skew) MUST be rejected.
A second use of a nonce already consumed MUST be rejected, even with an otherwise-valid signature.
A message part altered after signing MUST be rejected (requestHash recompute mismatch).
A contextId altered after signing MUST be rejected.
A taskId altered after signing MUST be rejected.
A proof signed by a key not published under the claimed DID MUST be rejected, even if kid syntactically names that DID.
A proof whose alg does not match the resolved key's type MUST be rejected.
A caller that drops a previously-asserted cnf binding does not silently upgrade to full trust - the gate MUST reflect the downgrade, never hide it.
A verified caller whose trust-extension status check reports revoked MUST be rejected, even with a fully valid A2A proof.
A verified caller whose trust-extension manifest/status check cannot be completed (stale, unresolvable) MUST be rejected, never treated as policy-absent.
The response proof MUST verify against the result as the client receives it, and MUST NOT verify against a different result.
Every rejection above MUST leave the task store byte-identical to before the rejected call - the executor never runs.
